## Terms

### Power BI DirectQuery

- **Power BI DirectQuery** · self — Power BI DirectQuery evaluates report requests against the underlying data source rather than using the standard Import-mode copy; MongoDB exposes this through its SQL Interface connector. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/connect.md
